entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: Chandra's mother, long thought dead, a quicksmith who leads the renegades of Ghirapur against the Consulate and is arrested at the end.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer and planeswalker who sees her mother alive, fights Consulate soldiers, and retreats in despair.

entities.name: Baral
entities.description: A masked Consulate officer and secret mage, scarred by Chandra, who tormented Pia in prison and hunted her family.

entities.name: Kiran Nalaar
entities.description: Pia's late husband and Chandra's father, a craftsman whose final project was Chandra's vent pack.

entities.name: Tamni
entities.description: A young inventor's apprentice who joins the renegades and is taught to quicksmith by Pia.

entities.name: Venkat
entities.description: A former high-ranking Consulate commander who defected to Pia's renegades and wears a stolen lieutenant's uniform.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: The Fair's Head Judge with a metal claw arm who arrests Pia, and whom Liliana knows.

entities.name: Dovin Baan
entities.description: The vedalken Minister of Inspections who accompanies Tezzeret and orders the soldiers to contain Chandra.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer and planeswalker who recognizes Tezzeret and hits Nissa with cruel words about Chandra.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elven planeswalker who follows Chandra to Kaladesh and accuses Liliana of provoking her.

entities.name: Oviya Pashiri
entities.description: A robed older woman who comforts Chandra and promises to help rescue her mother.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker whose scarred back Liliana remembers when she sees Tezzeret.

entities.name: Consulate
entities.description: The government of Kaladesh that tightly controls aether and arrests renegades.

entities.name: Renegades
entities.description: Citizens led by Pia who protest the Consulate's control of aether, using the leaking spire as their symbol.

entities.name: Maulfists
entities.description: A group of renegades whose foundry lost its aether.

entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: Chandra's home plane.

entities.name: Regatha
entities.description: Where Chandra went after her spark ignited, the site of fire monasteries.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: The capital city of Kaladesh where the Inventors' Fair takes place.

entities.name: Dhund
entities.description: The Consulate prison where Pia was held.

entities.name: Weldfast
entities.description: A district of Ghirapur where the renegades live and aether has been removed.

entities.name: Inventors' Fair
entities.description: The festival where the renegades stage their thopter display.

entities.name: Leaking Spire
entities.description: The renegades' symbol, a swirl of motion beneath a pointed spire.

events.summary: In a Dhund cell Baral tells Pia he killed her daughter and tosses a melted piece of Chandra's vent pack, stamped K.N. and the leaking spire, as a memento (flashback).
events.quote: I killed your daughter today, Pia.

events.summary: Pia recognizes the fragment as part of Kiran Nalaar's final project.
events.quote: a piece of Kiran Nalaar's final project

events.summary: Baral returns every day repeating that Chandra was looking for Pia, until Pia vows to return to expose him.
events.quote: And I'll return for her, for all those out there, so they know what you've done.

events.summary: Pia hurls an aether lamp that knocks off Baral's mask, revealing a blue flash, so he is a mage, and a scarred face.
events.quote: dislodged his mask with a clanging reverberation

events.summary: Baral blames Chandra for his scars and Pia answers that a mother could not be prouder.
events.quote: this is the work of your child.

events.summary: Alone in the dark, Pia begins to plan her escape.
events.quote: And began to plan.

events.summary: Years later, Pia has rallied a contingent of inventors and citizens as the renegades against the Consulate's grip on aether.
events.quote: Pia had rallied a growing contingent of inventors, tinkers, artists

events.summary: On a rooftop Pia coaches the inexperienced apprentice Tamni through repairing a thopter.
events.quote: You'll be fine, but we'll need to be fast.

events.summary: Venkat, a former Consulate commander, joins Pia disguised in a lieutenant's uniform.
events.quote: Once a high-ranking commander of the Consulate guard forces

events.summary: Pia rallies the renegades, listing grievances about the Consulate taking their aether, before the display.
events.quote: Let us be as proud, unafraid, unyielding as those who believe they can extinguish our spirits!

events.summary: The renegades launch nearly a hundred thopters that form a glittering column over the fairgrounds.
events.quote: The machines dove through the air to opposite ends of the plaza, nearly a hundred in number.

events.summary: The thopters change colors and form the leaking spire symbol over the Fair.
events.quote: As the metal of the thopters heated, their colors changed through yellows to greens to rich purples and blues

events.summary: The thopters release a pulse of aether that topples the Consulate automatons.
events.quote: The sudden rush of energy flooded into the identical automata, creating sparks of concentrated aether.

events.summary: Tezzeret, flanked by automatons and Dovin Baan, seizes Pia with his metal claw.
events.quote: The hand that gripped her arm was a massive claw of dark metal

events.summary: Tezzeret calls Pia the Renegade Prime and she vows to stop him.
events.quote: I've found you at last, Renegade Prime

events.summary: Liliana appears and names Tezzeret, and he names her Vess in return.
events.quote: A pale woman clad in dark flowing silks and a glinting golden headpiece appeared opposite the Head Judge.

events.summary: Pia sees Chandra, grown and unmistakable, and is flooded with memories.
events.quote: Older but unmistakable. Her little girl, now even taller than Kiran had been.

events.summary: Chandra charges the soldiers and burns a crowd of automatons.
events.quote: inundated a crowd of the machines with a generous bath of flames

events.summary: Baan orders the soldiers to isolate and contain the pyromancer with gearhulks.
events.quote: Isolate and contain. Gearhulks in the front line

events.summary: Nissa's vines topple guards moving on Chandra.
events.quote: Several of them toppled, feet tangled in a hissing whirl of flowered vines

events.summary: To protect Chandra, Pia announces herself as the renegade leader and surrenders to Consulate custody.
events.quote: My name is Pia Nalaar, leader of the renegades. I'm prepared to enter Consulate custody.

events.summary: Soldiers manacle Pia and read out her crimes.
events.quote: you are hereby placed under the authority of the Consulate for the following crimes

events.summary: Pia kicks and bashes soldiers to draw Chandra's attention and stop her advance.
events.quote: You forgot assault!

events.summary: Liliana tells Chandra they must retreat as the soldiers drag Pia away.
events.quote: They have her! You can't risk it now; we have to go!

events.summary: Liliana recalls Jace's scars when she thinks of Tezzeret and warns he is dangerous.
events.quote: Jace, his back stitched with ugly white scars from a manablade.

events.summary: Nissa angrily confronts Liliana for leaving without telling the others.
events.quote: Why did you leave without letting us know?

events.summary: Liliana cruelly tells Nissa that Chandra ran from her and came to Liliana.
events.quote: She ran from you

events.summary: Oviya Pashiri comforts Chandra and says they will free her mother from the Consulate.
events.quote: when we find your mother and take her back from those Consulate soldiers, Chandra.

relations.quote: Older but unmistakable. Her little girl, now even taller than Kiran had been.

relations.note: Kiran was her husband; she is a widow.
relations.quote: Don't you have better things to do than to hound a grieving widow?

relations.note: He hunted her family and imprisoned her.
relations.quote: The voice of the man who had hunted her family: Captain Baral.
this is the work of your child.

relations.note: A defected commander who trusts her.
relations.quote: I'm just one of many wise enough to place their trust in you

relations.note: She teaches the apprentice to listen to the metal.
relations.quote: But you'll learn its patterns even if you don't understand it completely

relations.note: She calls herself the leader of the renegades.
relations.quote: My name is Pia Nalaar, leader of the renegades.

relations.note: He hunts and arrests the Renegade Prime.
relations.quote: I've found you at last, Renegade Prime

relations.note: He is the Consulate's Minister of Inspections.
relations.quote: the stately vedalken Minister of Inspections himself, Dovin Baan

relations.note: She knew Chandra as a child and vows to help free Pia.
relations.quote: It's been a while since I've seen you last, child,

relations.note: She warns that Tezzeret is a great threat.
relations.quote: Tezzeret is more threat than you could know.
